description: Test class for CanvasController snapshot parameter parsing, verifying default values, parsing of formats, and quality clamping.

classes.name: CanvasControllerSnapshotParamsTest
classes.description: Test suite for CanvasController snapshot parameter parsing methods.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsDefaultsToJpeg
methods.description: Tests that parsing null snapshot parameters defaults to JPEG format.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesPng
methods.description: Tests parsing of a JSON string with format 'png' and maxWidth 900.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsParsesJpegAliases
methods.description: Tests that 'jpeg' and 'jpg' strings are correctly interpreted as JPEG format.

methods.name: parseSnapshotParamsClampsQuality
methods.description: Tests that 'quality' values below 0.1 are clamped to 0.1 and above 1.0 are clamped to 1.0.
